met_analysis:
The Low Pressure area over Gangetic West Bengal and adjoining Jharkhand & north Odisha persisted at 1430 hrs IST of today, 17th July, 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extends upto 5.8 km above mean sea level tilting southwestwards with height. It is very likely to weaken gradually during next 24 hrs.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level continues to pass through Amritsar, Chandigarh, Shahjahanpur, Basti, Patna, centre of Low Pressure area over Gangetic West Bengal and adjoining Jharkhand & north Odisha and thence southeastwards towards Northeast Bay of Bengal extending upto 0.9 km above mean sea level.
The Western Disturbance as cyclonic circulation over north Pakistan & neighbourhood at 5.8 km above mean sea level with a trough aloft with its axis at 7.6 km above mean sea level roughly along Long. 67°E to the north of Lat. 30°N persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over north Haryana & neighbourhood at 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over southwest Rajasthan & neighbourhood at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Northeast Assam & neighbourhood extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough from North Lakshadweep area to southwest Bay of Bengal across north Kerala, South Interior Karnataka and north Tamilnadu at 7.6 km above mean sea level persists.
